articles.title: Juice Gets a Gravity Boost from Earth
articles.summary: ESA’s Juice spacecraft passed Earth on September 28, using gravity to change direction and gain speed. The encounter also helped teams test instruments for studying Jupiter’s icy moons.

articles.title: A Model Shows How California’s Earthquake ‘Gate’ Works
articles.summary: Scientists modeled 1,000 years of earthquakes on two Southern California fault systems. Their results suggest that stress near a key junction can affect whether a rupture stops or continues.

articles.title: How Gas Helps Some Animals Float
articles.summary: Gas can do useful jobs underwater. Manatees can store it in their guts to float more easily, while sand tiger sharks gulp air that helps them hover.
